narrative: A privilege transition was detected through sudo execution. This indicates that the authenticated account obtained higher local privileges and requires investigation. Observed command(s): /bin/bash; /usr/bin/id; /usr/bin/cat /etc/shadow.
Credential-access behavior was observed, indicating possible attempts to obtain or inspect authentication material.
Network reconnaissance activity was detected, indicating possible enumeration of services, network configuration, or active connections.
Persistence-related activity was detected, suggesting a possible attempt to maintain access beyond the initial session.
Remote content transfer or command-and-control behavior was observed.
attack_story.conclusion: The available evidence contains a privilege transition that requires investigation. Observed user=analyst, root. Overall assessed risk is CRITICAL (100/100).
